acceptance_gates.title: Four Detection Rules Functional Implementation
acceptance_gates.description: Rules R1–R4 implemented: R1 Large Transfer (tx unit, p99/fallback 10 ETH/token threshold), R2 High Frequency (address_window unit, >= 10 outgoing events in 300s window), R3 Fan-in / Fan-out (address_window unit, >= 8 unique counterparties in 900s, FAN_IN vs FAN_OUT distinguished), R4 Rapid Pass-through (address_window unit, <= 5 blocks delta, ratio 0.80-1.05, outgoing after incoming). Exact integer and Decimal arithmetic used with zero binary float precision loss.
acceptance_gates.verification_method: Code inspection of forensics/rules/ (large_transfer.py, high_frequency.py, fan_in_out.py, rapid_pass_through.py) and pytest execution of tests/test_rules.py
acceptance_gates.evidence: Exact integer/Decimal arithmetic verified across all rules; 32/32 tests pass covering threshold calculations, ratio boundaries, and event aggregations.

acceptance_gates.title: Asset Coverage (ETH & ERC-20)
acceptance_gates.description: Evaluates native ETH (asset_id='NATIVE', log_index=-1) and ERC-20 token contracts (asset_id=contract_address, log_index>=0) without cross-asset or cross-chain contamination.
acceptance_gates.verification_method: Execution of test_r1_erc20_explicit_threshold_and_boundaries, test_cross_asset_zero_contamination, and test_cross_chain_isolation in tests/test_rules.py
acceptance_gates.evidence: Zero cross-asset leakage confirmed; NATIVE ETH and ERC-20 tokens evaluate independently; cross-chain isolation verified.

acceptance_gates.title: Boundary Conditions & Window Constraints
acceptance_gates.description: Rigorous boundary verification: exact amounts (below, exact, above, uint256 max 2^256-1), time windows (299s, 300s, 301s; 899s, 900s, 901s), counterparty counts (7 vs 8), block distances (0 blocks same-block, 5 blocks valid, 6 blocks excluded; outgoing preceding incoming excluded), and strict calibration/test window non-overlapping enforcement.
acceptance_gates.verification_method: Boundary tests in tests/test_rules.py (test_r1_native_eth_exact_boundaries_and_uint256_max, test_r2_time_window_boundaries_299_300_301, test_r3_counterparty_boundary_7_vs_8, test_r4_ratio_exact_limits_080_and_105, test_r4_block_distance_boundary_6_blocks, test_r4_outgoing_before_incoming_negative, test_r1_non_overlapping_calibration_enforced)
acceptance_gates.evidence: All boundary conditions behave strictly according to specification; ValueError raised when cal_end_block >= test_start_block.

acceptance_gates.title: Integrity & Canonical Block Filtering
acceptance_gates.description: Only canonical blocks (blocks.status = 'canonical') contribute to alerts and calibration; orphaned, reorged, and uncle blocks are strictly excluded.
acceptance_gates.verification_method: Static SQL inspection and test_canonical_vs_orphaned_exclusion and test_orphaned_blocks_excluded_across_all_rules in tests/test_rules.py
acceptance_gates.evidence: All SQL queries join blocks b with b.status = 'canonical'; orphaned blocks produce zero alerts across R1-R4.

acceptance_gates.title: Idempotency & Alert Provenance
acceptance_gates.description: Alert IDs are deterministic SHA-256 digests; re-running produces identical alert IDs; SQLite persistence uses INSERT OR REPLACE ensuring zero duplicate alerts; every alert evidence_refs accurately resolves to canonical source records; CLI analyze supports JSON and CSV exports.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Idempotent rerun generates 100% matching alert_id digests; verify_refs confirms every evidence ref resolves to asset_transfers, transactions, and canonical blocks; CLI analyze successfully exports to JSON and CSV.

acceptance_gates.title: Synthetic Dataset Integration & Isolation

acceptance_gates.verification_method: Inspection of tests/p4_fixtures.py, execution with --basetemp, and SHA-256 re-verification of data/forensics.db and results/ baseline DBs
acceptance_gates.evidence: All write tests use isolated temporary SQLite instances; protected baseline DBs remain 100% bit-for-bit unchanged.

acceptance_gates.title: Real Ethereum Exploit Dataset Evaluation
acceptance_gates.description: Evaluation of detection rules R1–R4 against verified real Ethereum Mainnet incident datasets (Euler Finance DAI and Curve/Alchemix alETH). Ingests 7,032 asset transfers (6,858 verified ERC-20, 152 incident ERC-20, 6 top-level ETH, 16 Alchemy internal ETH) across 1,789 canonical blocks into isolated data/real_p4.db; enforces non-overlapping calibration/test windows; evaluates native ETH and ERC-20 tokens; generates 172 deterministic alerts with 10-field evidence references and zero threshold mutations.
acceptance_gates.verification_method: Execution of forensics/real_data_ingest.py, scripts/run_real_rules.py, tests/test_real_data_ingest.py, tests/test_real_data_rules.py, and tests/test_challenger1_adversarial.py
acceptance_gates.evidence: All 7,032 transfers ingested without float precision loss; 16/16 internal ETH normalized to NATIVE with negative log_indices; 172 alerts generated (Euler: 58, Curve: 114); 100% deterministic alert IDs and 10-field evidence_refs; Euler frontrun tx 0xc310... matches 10 alerts; Curve exploit tx 0xb676... matches 10 alerts; 14 internal ETH alerts triggered; all 57 tests pass (100%).
